children: Volato Group engaged Christopher M. Ensey as Chief Executive Officer under an Executive Services Agreement effective September 11, 2026.
Chief Executive Officer; member of the Board of Directors
To provide services in connection with closing of merger with Alignment Engine Inc.
Previously served as CEO of Alignment Engine Inc.; will perform services principally from Puerto Rico; engaged as independent contractor
Board will nominate Mr. Ensey for re-election while he serves as CEO; he will resign from the Board upon termination of services
